title: SEC EDGAR Company Filings
description: List a public company's SEC filings from EDGAR by ticker, name or CIK: form type, filing and report dates, 8-K items, description and direct links to the document and filing index. Filter by form (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, S-1, DEF 14A...) and date.
useCases: Analysts and AI agents pulling every 8-K or 10-K for a watchlist
Compliance and IR teams monitoring peers

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Tickers, exact company names or CIK numbers.

filedSince.title: Filed on or after (YYYY-MM-DD)
filedSince.description: Only filings on or after this date.

limits: Reads EDGAR's 'recent' submissions block (the last ~1,000 filings per company).
